summary.en: US stocks slip amid Iran escalation concerns despite Trump-Xi summit progress. S&P 500 at 7,408, Nasdaq at 26,225, Dow at 49,526. Oil surges to $107.57/barrel on Trump 'clock ticking' threat to Iran creating stagflation toggle risk. 10Y Treasury yield at 4.60% remains elevated on persistent inflation. NVDA May 20 earnings anticipation mixed with geopolitical uncertainty. New Fed Chair Warsh faces challenging inflation environment with CPI 3.8%, PPI 6%. Market fragility at record highs despite trade truce extension.
summary.zh: 美股受伊朗升级担忧影响下滑尽管Trump-Xi峰会进展。标普 500 7,408 纳指 26,225 道指 49,526。油飙升至$107.57/桶因Trump对Iran'倒计时'威胁造成滞胀切换风险。10Y 美债收益率 4.60% 因持续通胀维持高位。NVDA 5 月 20 日财报期待与地缘不确定混合。新 Fed 主席 Warsh 面临挑战通胀环境 CPI 3.8% PPI 6%。市场高位脆弱 despite 贸易休战延长。

title.en: Trump Warns Iran 'Clock Is Ticking': Oil Spikes to $107.57, Stocks Slip Amid Escalation Fears
title.zh: Trump 警告 Iran'倒计时'：油飙升至$107.57 股市因升级担忧下滑

impact.en: President Trump issued warning to Iran that 'clock is ticking' regarding ongoing conflict, sending oil futures sharply higher. Brent crude jumped to $107.57/barrel (+2.4%) while WTI reached $103+/barrel. US stock futures slipped initially before stabilizing as investors assessed escalation risk. Strait of Hormuz remains open but ceasefire talks stall. Market reactions reflect stagflation toggle: oil strength supports energy sector fundamentals but pressure on growth stocks from inflation fears. Energy sector names including XLE, XOP, CVX, XOM, OXY benefited from price surge. Trump-Xi summit progress provides some geopolitical relief but Iran conflict remains primary risk driver. Watch for $110+ level if escalation intensifies; $95 support critical. China opposition to militarization of strait acknowledged but no formal agreement on tolls or shipping restrictions. Oil volatility key toggle between inflation fears and growth concerns.

topNews.zh: Trump 总统向 Iran 发出'倒计时'警告关于 ongoing 冲突 推高油期货。Brent 原油飙升至$107.57/桶 (+2.4%) WTI 达到$103+/桶。美股期货最初下滑随后稳定因投资者评估升级风险。霍尔木兹海峡保持开放但停火谈判停滞。市场反应反映滞胀切换：油价支撑能源基本面但对成长股造成通胀压力。能源板块 XLE XOP CVX XOM OXY 受益于价格飙升。Trump-Xi 峰会进展提供部分地缘缓解但 Iran 冲突仍是主要风险驱动。若升级 intensify 关注$110+ 水平；$95 支撑关键。中国反对军事化海峡已确认但无正式协议关于通行费或航运限制。油价波动通胀担忧和增长担忧关键切换器。

title.en: Treasury Yields Surge: 10Y at 4.60% as CPI PPI Data Shows Persistent Inflation Pressures
title.zh: 美债收益率飙升：10Y 至 4.60% CPI PPI 数据显示持续通胀压力

impact.en: US Treasury yields remain elevated with 10Y at 4.60% and 30Y approaching 5.1% following recent inflation data. CPI at 3.8% and PPI at 6% exceed expectations creating pressure on rate cut expectations. New Fed Chair Warsh faces complex environment as President Trump continues pushing for rate cuts while data shows persistent inflation. Import prices surged 4.2% annually on energy and commodity price increases. Fed policy uncertainty persists with Powell's June 11 meeting critical for rate path clarity. Long-end yield control creates pressure on duration assets including growth stocks and bond ETFs. Yield curve remains inverted with 2s10s narrowing. Market positioning reflects mixed signals: Trump-Xi trade truce supports risk-on sentiment but inflation reality creates duration sensitivity. 10Y yield direction critical for growth stock valuations and bond ETF performance.

topNews.zh: 美债收益率维持高位 10Y 4.60% 30Y 近 5.1% 继近期通胀数据。CPI 3.8% PPI 6% 超出预期造成降息预期压力。新 Fed 主席 Warsh 面临复杂环境 Trump 总统继续推动降息而数据显示持续通胀。进口价格因能源和大宗商品价格飙升 4.2% 年化。Fed 政策不确定持续 Powell 6 月 11 日会议对利率路径清晰关键。长端收益率控制造成久期资产包括成长股和债券 ETF 压力。收益率曲线仍 inverted 2s10s 收窄。市场仓位反映混合信号：Trump-Xi 贸易休战支持风险偏好但通胀现实造成久期敏感。10Y 收益率方向对成长股估值和债券 ETF 表现关键。

title.en: NVIDIA Earnings Preview: May 20 Report Key for AI/Growth Stock Sentiment Amid Market Highs
title.zh: NVIDIA 财报前瞻：5 月 20 日报表对 AI/成长股情绪关键在市场高位

impact.en: NVIDIA (NVDA) reports Q1 FY27 earnings on May 20 with analysts expecting revenue around $78 billion. Morgan Stanley and Bernstein increasing bullishness on AI data center growth. NVDA May 20 anticipation drives semiconductor and AI names. However earnings miss risk on data center guidance creates fragility at record highs. S&P 500 at 7,408 and Nasdaq at 26,225 reflect growth stock concentration. Market positioning favors growth but valuation fragility concerns emerge. Regeneron, Dominion Energy, Macy's among stocks making biggest premarket moves. NVDA guidance critical for broader tech sentiment and AI investment thesis. Semiconductor sector leads market rally but volatility risk increases with mixed inflation backdrop. Watch for NVDA May 20 data center guidance as key catalyst for growth stock trajectory.

topNews.zh: NVIDIA (NVDA) 5 月 20 日发布 Q1 FY27 财报分析师预期收入约$78 亿。Morgan Stanley 和 Bernstein 因 AI 数据中心增长增加看涨。NVDA 5 月 20 日期待驱动半导体和 AI 名目。但财报不及预期数据中心指引风险创造高位脆弱性。标普 500 7,408 纳指 26,225 反映成长股集中。市场仓位偏好成长但估值脆弱性担忧出现。Regeneron, Dominion Energy, Macy's 等股票开盘最大异动。NVDA 指引对 broader tech 情绪和 AI 投资逻辑关键。半导体板块领涨但波动风险增加因混合通胀背景。关注 NVDA 5 月 20 日数据中心指引对成长股轨迹关键催化剂。

title.en: Dollar Strength: DXY Elevated on Middle East Uncertainty and Inflation Concerns
title.zh: 美元走强：DXY 因中东不确定和通胀担忧高位

impact.en: DXY remains elevated on USD safe-haven demand from Middle East uncertainty and global inflation concerns. Dollar strength supported by import price surge 4.2% annual and energy price spike. JPY/USD volatility adds FX complexity with yields attracting capital. USD benefits from geopolitical risk flows and higher yields despite Trump pushing for rate cuts. New Fed Chair Warsh policy path critical for USD trajectory. Watch for dollar rotation if Trump-Xi de-escalation persists and Middle East tensions ease. FX headwinds for multinational earnings remain significant. Yield surge supports dollar but inflation uncertainty creates volatility. China opposition to US oil purchases unconfirmed despite Trump claims. DXY trajectory depends on Iran conflict resolution and Fed policy clarity.

topNews.zh: DXY 维持高位因美元中东不确定和全球通胀担忧的避险需求。美元走强受进口价格飙升 4.2% 年化和能源价格飙升支撑。JPY/USD 波动增加货币复杂性收益率吸引资本。美元因地缘风险资金流和更高收益率受益尽管 Trump 推动降息。新 Fed 主席 Warsh 政策路径关键对美元轨迹。关注若 Trump-Xi 降级持续和中东紧张缓解美元轮动。跨国企业盈利货币压力持续存在。收益率飙升支持美元但通胀不确定创造波动。中国反对美国石油购买未确认尽管 Trump 声称。DXY 轨迹取决于 Iran 冲突解决和 Fed 政策清晰。

title.en: China-US Trade Truce Extension: Export Backdrop Improves Despite Mixed Data
title.zh: 中美贸易休战延长：出口背景改善尽管数据混合

impact.en: Trump-Xi summit provides positive export backdrop with trade truce extension. China's No. 2 chip foundry HHGrace confirms compliance with US export controls. Deloitte reports China doesn't need major stimulus despite disappointing April data. However Trump-Xi deal implementation vague with unconfirmed oil purchases. Trump claimed China will buy oil with ships to Texas, Louisiana, Alaska but details remain unclear. China opposition to Strait of Hormuz militarization acknowledged. Export sector benefits from de-escalation but energy purchase confirmation critical. Market sentiment improved on summit progress but geopolitical risks remain. Trade truce extension supports risk-on bias but implementation details need clarity. Watch for formal announcements on energy purchase confirmations.

topNews.zh: Trump-Xi 峰会提供积极出口背景贸易休战延长。China 第 2 大芯片代工厂 HHGrace 确认遵守 US 出口管制。Deloitte 报告 China 无需重大刺激尽管 4 月数据失望。但 Trump-Xi 协议模糊石油购买未确认。Trump 声称 China 将购买石油船只前往德州 路易斯安那 阿拉斯加但细节不清。China 反对霍尔木兹海峡军事化已确认。出口部门从降级中受益但能源购买确认关键。市场情绪因峰会进展改善但地缘风险持续存在。贸易休战延长支持风险偏好但实施细节需要清晰。关注能源购买确认正式公告。

equityIndices.en: S&P 500: 7,408 (near record high); Nasdaq: 26,225 (new high); Dow: 49,526. Markets extended sixth consecutive rally driven by Trump-Xi trade truce and tech strength, but oil volatility creates fragility at elevated levels.
equityIndices.zh: 标普 500: 7,408 (近历史高位); 纳指: 26,225 (新高); 道指: 49,526。市场延续第六周 rallies 由 Trump-Xi 贸易休战和科技强劲驱动 但油波动创造高位脆弱性。

oil.zh: Brent: $107.57/桶 (+2.39%); WTI: $103.39/桶 (+2.79%)。Trump Iran 警告推高油价造成滞胀切换风险。$95-100 区间由需求和 OPEC+ 支撑；$110+ 需要升级。

keyEvents.en: - Trump 'clock ticking' warning to Iran (May 18): Oil spike to $107.57/barrel. Watch for $110+ if escalation intensifies. 2) NVDA earnings May 20: Data center guidance critical for AI sector. 3) Fed Chair Warsh faces complex inflation: CPI 3.8%, PPI 6%. 4) Powell June 11 meeting: Critical for rate path clarity. 5) Trump-Xi summit progress: Trade truce extension positive but details vague. 6) Strait of Hormuz: Open but China opposes militarization.
keyEvents.zh: - Trump Iran'倒计时'警告 (5 月 18): 油飙升至$107.57/桶。关注若升级 intensify $110+ 水平。2) NVDA 财报 5 月 20: 数据中心指引对 AI  sector 关键。3) Fed 主席 Warsh 面临复杂通胀: CPI 3.8% PPI 6%。4) Powell 6 月 11 日会议: 对利率路径清晰关键。5) Trump-Xi 峰会进展: 贸易休战延长正面但细节模糊。6) 霍尔木兹海峡: 开放但中国反对军事化。

keyRisk.en: Primary risks: 1) Iran ceasefire breakdown - oil back to $110-115 triggering stagflation surge. 2) Trump-Xi deal implementation vague with unconfirmed oil purchases. 3) NVDA May 20 earnings miss on data center guidance. 4) Fed policy uncertainty - new Chair Warsh faces complex inflation. 5) Middle East escalation - Strait of Hormuz. 6) Inflation data surprise - CPI/PCE above expectations. 7) Bond market volatility - 30Y yield near 5.1% pressures duration assets. 8) Market fragility at record highs - S&P 500 7,408, Nasdaq 26,225. Oil volatility key toggle between inflation fears and growth concerns.
keyRisk.zh: 主要风险：1) Iran 停火破裂 油价重返$110-115 触发滞胀飙升。2) Trump-Xi 协议模糊石油购买未确认。3) NVDA 5 月 20 日财报不及预期数据中心指引。4) Fed 政策不确定性 新主席 Warsh 面临复杂通胀。5) 中东升级 霍尔木兹海峡。6) 通胀数据意外 CPI/PCE 高于预期。7) 债市波动 30Y 收益率近 5.1% 压制造久期资产。8) 市场高位脆弱性 标普 500 7,408 纳指 26,225。油价波动通胀担忧和增长担忧间关键切换器。

note.en: Market extended sixth consecutive rally with S&P 500 and Nasdaq at record highs driven by Trump-Xi trade truce and tech strength. Tech sector leads with semiconductor and AI names strong on NVDA May 20 anticipation. However inflation surge creates significant uncertainty: CPI 3.8%, PPI 6%, import prices 4.2% annually. 10Y Treasury yield at 4.60% and 30Y near 5.1% pressuring duration assets. New Fed Chair Warsh faces challenging environment with Trump pushing for rate cuts while data shows persistent inflation. Oil volatility at $107.57/barrel creates stagflation toggle risk. Market positioning favors growth but record valuations create fragility to negative catalysts. Mixed signals from summit progress versus inflation reality warrant medium confidence with risk-on bias tempered by rate sensitivity concerns.
note.zh: 市场延续第六周 rallies 标普 500 和纳指创新高由 Trump-Xi 贸易休战和科技强劲驱动。科技板块领涨半导体和 AI 名目强劲 NVDA 5 月 20 日期待。然而通胀飙升创造重大不确定：CPI 3.8% PPI 6% 进口价格 4.2% 年化。10Y 美债收益率 4.60% 30Y 近 5.1% 压制造久期资产。新 Fed 主席 Warsh 面临挑战环境 Trump 推动降息而数据显示持续通胀。油价波动$107.57/桶造成滞胀切换风险。市场仓位偏好成长但历史估值创造对负面催化剂脆弱性。峰会进展 vs 通胀现实混合信号 warrant 中信心风险偏好偏向下受利率敏感性担忧制约。
